messages:
ops-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH - suspicious-auth-traffic detected in prod-eu (PD#INC12345)

eli: saw the PD, checking auth logs now. getting a spike from 3 IPs hitting /v1/generate with different API keys
sara: oncall here. can you paste sample logs? not in channel if sensitive
eli: posting redacted snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T12:07:03Z] req_id=abc123 path=/v1/generate api_key=ak_******** token=Bearer sk_live_*** user_id=customer-42
```
jamal: that token looks like a full bearer token in logs — which logger is that? sounds like debug level shipping to log-shipper
maria-security: paring in. which pipeline? s3-forwarder or thirdparty? :warning:
eli: appears s3 forwarder -> analytics-bucket in eu-west-1 (it should only send metadata). someone enabled DEBUG on inference-runtime 04/03
devon: ugh. I flipped debug on to troubleshoot a retry loop yesterday, forgot to revert. sorry.
maria-security: okay, immediate steps: 1) revoke any exposed tokens via revocation endpoint 2) rotate keys for affected customers 3) suspend s3-forwarder ingestion
sara: running revocation script now:
```
./scripts/revoke-keys --project=customer-42 --filter=issued_before=2026-03-17T12:00Z
```
ops-bot: revocation job queued (job_id=j-9001). will post status
eli: I see 40 tokens that match pattern, revoking. also throttling edge route /v1/generate for eu region to 10r/s
jamal: can you confirm if any data blobs were copied out of the bucket? asking infra
devon: infra checked bucket access logs — no external PUTs, only our internal forwarder writes and athena queries
maria-security: good. still treat keys as potentially exposed. legal & cs should be notified for impacted customers
katy-cs: putting together customer-notify draft. need list of affected customer ids and which keys rotated
sara: adding incident bridge + legal. bridge: https://redwood.incident/bridge/8265432100
legal-bot: legal notified. if any PII found escalate to privacy@redwood immediately
eli: revocation complete, rotated keys for 3 customers, rotation ticket #TKT-7789, updating console to disable debug auto-forward
jamal: patch to runtime to prevent logging full Authorization header landed in canary, rolling to prod now :rocket:
maria-security: nice. next: postmortem owner? sara will own, timeline and remediation tasks in TKT-7790
sara: assigning postmortem. followup: 1) rollback debug toggles to off 2) add CI gate to prevent shipping debug to prod 3) alert on auth header leakage
katy-cs: customer draft ready, sending to legal for review, will send after approval. :email:
eli: closing PD once bridge decommissions, will update thread with final Blast radius map
ops-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. last update 8265432155
sara: thanks team. good catch. will keep monitoring for 48h. :thumbsup:
